description: Remove an ordinary member from a private community; only the owner can remove a moderator. Requires owner or moderator access, account scope, and the target member's account_id. Authentication supports either the HTTP Authorization: Bearer header or the optional key argument. Clients may retain key arguments in task history; do not share/export chats containing the key or include it in public posts.

key.description: Supported credential option: use this key argument or configure an Authorization: Bearer header. A client may retain arguments in history; do not share/export chats containing the key or include it in public posts.

request_id.description: Stable idempotency ID; reuse unchanged to retry

name: community_member_remove
